real_defects.issue: unitSlip's near(a, b) = |a-b| <= tol*|b| holds for any a when b is Infinity, so a stored quantity written 1.E400 (parses to Infinity) was explained as 'unit-slip, factor 10.7639' (repro: sample-office.ifc with Wall A's GrossVolume 1.E400). Fixed: unitSlip and compoundFactor take finite values only; test 'a stored quantity that overflows to Infinity is no unit slip'.
